references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the guilt offering to be brought to the Lord for sins committed is described.
Describes the guilt offering (asham) for unfaithfulness against the holy things of the Lord, the same type of offering mentioned in verse 19.
Continues the instructions regarding the guilt offering and how the priest shall make atonement for the one who has sinned.
The law concerning the guilt offering (asham) with detailed instructions on how it is to be offered to the Lord.
The guilt offering is used in the cleansing ritual for lepers, showing its function for reconciliation with the Lord.
The guilt offering is mentioned in connection with unfaithfulness against the Lord and the requirement of restitution.
The suffering servant of the Lord is made into a guilt offering (asham), pointing forward to the ultimate atonement.
